import hqfbp

## Optmized Headers

Conceptually header could be thought as Json but with a compact encoding.

```json
{  
  "Message-Id": 42,
  "Src-Callsign": "FOSM-1",
  "Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=UTF-8",
  "File-Size": 8
}
```

```{python}
packed = hqfbp.pack({
    "Message-Id": 42,
    "Src-Callsign": "FOSM-1",
    "Content-Type": "text/plain;charset=UTF-8",
    "File-Size": 8,
}, b"")
print(packed.hex(' '))
print("#bytes:", len(packed))
```

## Encodings examples

```{python}
lorem_ipsum = "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipiscing elit. Sed do eiusmod tempor incididunt ut labore et dolore magna aliqua. Ut enim ad minim veniam, quis nostrud exercitation ullamco laboris nisi ut aliquip ex ea commodo consequat. Duis aute irure dolor in reprehenderit in voluptate velit esse cillum dolore eu fugiat nulla pariatur. Excepteur sint occaecat cupidatat non proident, sunt in culpa qui officia deserunt mollit anim id est laborum."

print("Lenght of payload:", len(lorem_ipsum))

from hqfbp import HQFBP_CBOR_KEYS
from hqfbp.generator import PDUGenerator
from hqfbp.deframer import Deframer, MessageEvent

print("| Encodings | #PDUs | PDU sizes | Total size |")
print("| --- | --- | --- | --- |")
for enc in [["chunk(198)", "h", "crc16", "repeat(2)"],["gzip", "h", "chunk(233)", "rs(255,233)"],["gzip", "chunk(255)", "ax25", "crc16", "post_asm(0x7E)", "asm(0x7E)"],]:

  gen = PDUGenerator(
    src_callsign="FOSM-1",
    encodings=enc,
  )

  pdus = list(gen.generate(lorem_ipsum.encode()))
  print(f"| {', '.join(gen.encodings)} | {len(pdus)} | {[len(pdu) for pdu in pdus]} | {sum(len(pdu) for pdu in pdus)} |")
```
